caption: The drawing shows a small figurine of a person sitting side-saddle on an animal that resembles a sheep or a similar quadruped. The person is dressed in a long, pale-colored garment with black dots and a yellow collar, and wears a yellow hat or bonnet with a dark band and black dots. The person’s face is pale with visible facial features including eyes, eyebrows, a nose, and lips stained red. The animal is also pale in color, with dark eyes and black outlines accentuating the mouth and collar area. Both the person and the animal are positioned on an oval base, sharing similar coloring throughout, predominantly in muted gray or off-white shades, with selective highlights in yellow, black, and red. The background is plain and off-white.
title: Chalkware Figure - Mary and Her Sheep
